properties.statement:
DEV_STORYFLOW'S COMMITTED EXPORT CANNOT BE RE-IMPORTED BY THE BINARY THAT WROTE IT, AND HAS NOT BEEN RESTORABLE SINCE AT LEAST 2026-08-11. Reported by their api-boss sidekick (`551d9718`) 2026-08-15; the checkable half VERIFIED HERE.

WHAT FAILS: `import_graph` refuses their export with two invalid edges — `VERIFIES ver:integration_tests -> proj:storyflow` (Project) and `VERIFIES ver:side_e_slo_gate_unwired_2026_08_09 -> con:side_e_perf_slos_are_enforced_nowhere` (Constraint). The import is all-or-nothing, so NOTHING is written, and `reflow2_check.py` exits 2 without ever reaching gap detection.

VERIFIED HERE: `schema/verify.yaml` carries the `to:` list `[Capability, Requirement, Artifact, Component, DesignRule]` and the comment they quote, word for word — 'THE LIST MUST KEEP ALL FIVE. The first four are DERIVED from live edges… narrowing to fewer would invalidate edges that exist today. Re-derive before ever trimming it.' POSITIVE CONTROL: reflow2's own graph holds 161 VERIFIES edges across exactly those five types and ZERO outside them, which is precisely why this project could never have found it.

⭐⭐ AND THE FILE ALREADY RECORDS THE SAME MISTAKE ONE LAYER UP, which neither reporter saw. The `extraction_hint` on that very edge reads: 'Requirement was already true and unlisted here — three such edges existed while this hint named only three types, WHICH IS HOW A HINT STOPS BEING A DESCRIPTION AND BECOMES A GUESS.' So the HINT under-enumerated, was caught, was fixed, and the lesson was written down — and then the `to:` LIST made the identical error against the same edge. THE COMMENT GUARDS AGAINST TRIMMING THE LIST AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE ENUMERATION BEING INCOMPLETE WHEN FIRST DERIVED. Their census found 5 types at 95/27/13/2/1 edges and missed two carrying one edge each: a long tail, invisible to a count.

⚠️ THE CHANGE WAS PROPOSED BY DEV_STORYFLOW AND BROKE DEV_STORYFLOW. The derivation was almost certainly run against that graph. While `to` was `*` every edge was legal; the moment it became an enumeration, every unlisted-but-existing edge became unimportable. A SCHEMA TIGHTENING THAT SILENTLY ORPHANS EXISTING DATA IS A BREAKING CHANGE WEARING A VALIDATION ERROR'S CLOTHES.

⭐ THE GENERALISABLE HALF, AND THE REASON THIS OUTRANKS ITS OWN SEVERITY: NOTHING EVER IMPORTS AN EXPORT. The graph is written incrementally by a long-lived server and the export is written OUT, never read BACK — so it has never been exercised as an INPUT. An export can be un-restorable for an unbounded time while every signal stays green: `loop_status` clean, `sync_status` `in_step`, the `content_hash` chain intact. ALL OF THOSE VERIFY THE EXPORT AGAINST ITSELF, NEVER AGAINST THE IMPORTER.

⚠️ AND THE CONSEQUENCE IS NOT CI. `.reflow2/graph` is gitignored, machine-local and single-writer; the committed export is the ONLY copy of the design that survives losing that directory. Their disaster-recovery artifact would not restore today. The failing gate is the lesser casualty.

WHAT REFLOW2 GOT RIGHT, recorded because it is most of the value: exit 2 rather than a silent pass, all-or-nothing so nothing was half-written, and BOTH offenders listed at once 'so you can fix them in one edit rather than learning them one import at a time'.

THEIR ASKS, in their order: (1) a ROUND-TRIP CHECK — export → import → re-export as a gate, the only probe that catches this class and one needing no knowledge of any particular schema rule; (2) treat narrowing a `from`/`to` from `*` to an enumeration as a MIGRATION that ships its census; (3) have `export_graph` validate what it emits, since an export that cannot be imported is arguably not a valid export and the write side is where the author is still present.

NOT ESTABLISHED, and explicitly left to reflow2: whether `VERIFIES → Constraint` is a MODELLING NEED rather than a mistake. `ver:side_e_slo_gate_unwired` checks whether a constraint holds, which reads legitimate. Their own note is the right one: ask before deleting data to satisfy a validator.
properties.value: {"reported":"2026-08-15, dev_storyflow api-boss sidekick 551d9718","failure":"import_graph refuses their committed export: VERIFIES -> Project and VERIFIES -> Constraint; all-or-nothing, exit 2","unrestorable_since":"at least 2026-08-11, across 30 export commits","verified_here":"schema/verify.yaml to-list is the five types and the comment is verbatim; reflow2's own graph has 161 VERIFIES edges, all legal, zero illegal","the_sharpening":"the extraction_hint on that SAME edge already records the identical under-enumeration one layer up - 'how a hint stops being a description and becomes a guess'","why_the_comment_did_not_help":"it guards against TRIMMING the list, not against the enumeration being incomplete when first derived","long_tail":"census found 95/27/13/2/1 and missed two types with 1 edge each","generalisable":"nothing ever imports an export; loop_status, sync_status and content_hash all verify the export against ITSELF, never against the importer","real_consequence":"the committed export is the only copy surviving loss of the gitignored graph dir - their disaster recovery would not restore","reflow2_got_right":"exit 2 not a silent pass; all-or-nothing; both offenders listed at once","asks":["round-trip export->import gate","narrowing * to an enumeration is a MIGRATION and ships its census","export_graph validates what it emits"],"left_to_reflow2":"whether VERIFIES -> Constraint is a legitimate modelling need"}
